description: This file contains the implementation of database operations related to boards and blocks in the focalboard project, including creation, patching, deletion, and duplication of boards and blocks, as well as custom error handling.

classes.name: BlockDoesntBelongToBoardsErr
classes.description: Custom error type indicating a block does not belong to any of the specified boards.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for BlockDoesntBelongToBoardsErr.

methods.name: createBoardsAndBlocksWithAdmin
methods.description: Creates boards and blocks with admin rights, assigns admin members to the boards.

methods.name: createBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Creates new boards and blocks in the database based on provided data.

methods.name: patchBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Patches existing boards and blocks with provided updates.

methods.name: deleteBoardsAndBlocks
methods.description: Deletes specified boards and blocks, ensuring blocks belong to the specified boards.

methods.name: duplicateBoard
methods.description: Duplicates an existing board, optionally as a template or to a specific team.
